title: WTShiftBench: a problem-solving benchmark protocol for endpoint-aligned auditing of transcriptomic perturbation model outputs
description: WTShiftBench English public assets prepared on 15 September 2026: sampling-aware endpoints, explicit target/gene axes, five-seed CellOT evaluation, and reported training/feature-seed checks. Public text and source annotations are translated; scientific values, axes, seeds, and checkpoint tensors are unchanged. New file and ZIP hashes identify this derivative. The author selected the v1.2.0 publication label after removing earlier v1.2.x GitHub releases; exact commit and hashes distinguish this distribution from historical records. The code snapshot does not contain the complete matrix/training archives. Use reproducibility/v1.2.0/ for current guidance and precise verification scope.
